name: YouthCity Government and Policy in Action (Salt Lake City)
what_you_do: High school students work with city leaders on city issues. They learn about public policy and public sector careers. They plan community service projects. They work with the police Promising Youth program.
who_can_apply: Salt Lake City high school students. Summer interns are grades 9 to 12.
duration: School year: two groups meet Tuesdays and Thursdays, September 29, 2026 to April 29, 2027. Summer 2026: six weeks (Policy in Action Thursdays, Service Squad Tuesdays).
deadline_text: The 2026 to 2027 school year program is no longer taking applications. Summer 2026 programs ran June 9 to July 16. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: The pages do not describe how to apply. Contact Angela Romero or Lucy Leishman at 385-299-5647.
notes: The Salt Lake City site would not load in a regular reader, so this came from a page summary. The teen page said applications were open until May 25. It also said no longer accepting. Confirm with the contact.
